instruction: Locate the DMV office locations in Virginia

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the locations page to find DMV office locations. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for location pages. Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation
Metric logic correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL matches the locations page pattern
Expected regex pattern '^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/locations' correctly matches the Virginia DMV locations page URL with optional www subdomain
Evaluator semantically verifies the instruction requirement: user successfully navigated from homepage to locations page to 'locate DMV office locations'
Complete coverage: the single requirement (navigate to locations page) is fully verified by the URL check
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree -> URL extraction -> regex pattern match -> verification result
